title: Mitigation of Unauthorized Electronic Funds Transfers & Social Engineering Scams
summary: Commercial banks and MFBs will NEVER request an OTP, PIN, CVV, or mobile app login password over phone or SMS.
remedial_actions: Immediately call your bank's official 24/7 helpline (from the back of your card) to temporarily block internet banking and debit cards.
File a formal dispute with your bank within 24 hours to initiate fund freeze protocols under SBP Consumer Protection Framework.
Never share 6-digit OTPs under pretext of account activation or fraudulent transaction reversal.
citation: State Bank of Pakistan BPRD Circular No. 02 of 2023

title: Reporting of Fraudulent, Obscene, and Scam SMS / Calls (Short Code 8866)
summary: Fraudulent messages claiming cash prizes (Jeeto Pakistan, BISP, Ehsaas) or lottery winnings are criminal schemes under PECA 2016.
remedial_actions: Forward the fraudulent sender number and SMS text to PTA shortcode 8866.
Block the sender number on your mobile handset immediately.
Report persistent extortion to PTA Toll-Free Consumer Protection Helpline 0800-55055.
citation: PTA Public Notice on Fraudulent Communications & Consumer Protection Act 1996

authority: Federal Investigation Agency (FIA) - Cyber Crime Wing
title: Electronic Forgery, Impersonation, and Identity Theft (Section 13 & 14 PECA 2016)
summary: Impersonating law enforcement, judiciary, or military personnel to extort funds carries up to 3 years imprisonment under Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act.
remedial_actions: Law enforcement agencies do NOT conduct arrests or settle criminal cases via Easypaisa, JazzCash, or wire transfer.
Do not transfer any 'bail' or 'clearance' money. Hang up immediately.
File an online complaint with FIA Cyber Crime Reporting Center at https://complaint.fia.gov.pk or visit nearest zonal office.
citation: Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act (PECA) 2016, Sections 13, 14 & 16

title: Credential Harvesting Phishing Domains & Typosquatting Defense
summary: Deceptive websites imitating Pakistani banks or mobile wallets often use non-standard TLDs (.xyz, .top) or IP addresses.
remedial_actions: Never enter your CNIC, banking username, password, or ATM PIN on any link received via SMS or WhatsApp.
Verify the exact domain URL. Pakistani banking portals only operate under official .pk or verified corporate top-level domains.
Report phishing URLs to report.phishing@pta.gov.pk for national firewall DNS blocking.
citation: National CERT Advisory (NCERT-ADV-2023-08) on Phishing and Smishing Mitigation
